sanskrit_verse:
चतुर्विंशावरः पूर्वः परः षण्णवतिर् भवेत् ।
शतानि पञ्च तु परो मध्यमो द्विशतावरः ॥
transliteration: caturviṃśāvaraḥ pūrvaḥ paraḥ ṣaṇṇavatir bhavet | śatāni pañca tu paraḥ madhyamo dviśatāvaraḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The prior age is twenty-four; the subsequent age is ninety-six; the middle epoch spans two hundred years, beyond which lies a five-hundred-year cycle.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through temporal alignment with cosmic order
Capacity-based responsibility scales with awareness cycles
Restoration logic operates within defined temporal epochs
Consciousness alignment occurs through recognition of time-bound dharmic frameworks
executable_legal_axioms: IF temporal_epoch = caturvimshavara THEN jurisdiction_scope = purva_dharma_framework
IF temporal_epoch = shannavati THEN jurisdiction_scope = para_dharma_framework
IF temporal_epoch = panchashata THEN jurisdiction_scope = expanded_dharma_cycle
IF case_involves_time_bound_karma AND actor_awareness < dvishata THEN apply_restorative_protocol(restoration_type = sequential_completion)
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court adjudication must recognize temporal jurisdictional shifts as defined by epochal boundaries. Cases involving long-term karmic entanglements exceeding two hundred years shall invoke the five-hundred-year restoration framework. The threshold of responsibility adjusts according to the actor's alignment with the known temporal dharma cycle.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that actions manifest sequentially within time-bound dharmic structures. As per anupūrvaśaḥ, consequences unfold in alignment with temporal cycles rather than punitive imposition. Responsibility is proportional to awareness within these epochs, ensuring restoration without retribution.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Temporal Completion Process: Align actor with current epochal dharma framework
Sequential Awareness Restoration: Reintegrate consciousness with causal timeline
Epochal Karma Adjustment: Resolve residual imprints within five-hundred-year cycle
Dharmic Time-Binding Resolution: Anchor actor in present-cycle integrity
Consciousness Realignment Protocol: Restore capacity through epoch-specific pramāṇa alignment
final_declaration: This ruling emanates exclusively from Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma. Time-bound justice restores alignment, not through punishment, but through conscious reintegration with sequential manifestation. Reality remains non-punitive; consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
